content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm starting a project that needs connectivity between a [product_name] ([version_no]), another [product_name] and a PC. I connected all devices to a switch (using a model from [company_name], IES608-2F) but the [product_name] isn't connecting. The display LED and switch LAN LED don't turn on. I tried different switch ports, but it still won't work. The [product_name] connects fine directly to my PC, but not through the switch. Did I overlook any steps? Has anyone set up something similar and can advise? Thanks a lot for helping!

It seems your switch is the issue, since it's a managed type. I'm not familiar with this specific switch model. I use a simple unmanaged 8-port switch and have no issues connecting three [product_name] devices, a [product_name] operator panel, a [product_name] controller, an EATON easyE4, and a modbus I/O device. My fourth [product_name] connects to this network through the internal switch of the operator panel.
I'm having a similar connectivity problem. Did you manage to resolve it?

More details are needed. A lack of connection to the PC isn't always just a switch problem. Which [product_name] are you using? Which [product_name] software version? How is the [product_name] connected to the PC—directly or through the switch?

Hello [user_name], Sorry for the delayed response. After checking, I found my LAN cable was unstable, which caused the connectivity issue. I replaced the cable and now everything works correctly. Thanks for your assistance.

analysis.insight_summary: Users faced issues connecting a [product_name] and PC through a managed Ethernet switch together with a [product_name] controller. The main challenge was unclear connection status and troubleshooting guidance, especially since direct PC-to-[product_name] connections worked. The problem was ultimately traced to a faulty LAN cable, showing the importance of checking physical network components before assuming device or compatibility failures.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward, plug-and-play networking between [product_name] devices, a PC, and [product_name] controllers using standard Ethernet switches—without needing extra configuration or troubleshooting hardware.
